about: The epistola of the formulary “Septuagesima Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Brothers: Do you not know that those who run in the stadium all run indeed, but one receives the prize? Run in this way, that you may obtain it. Everyone who competes in the games abstains from all things; they indeed do so to receive a perishable crown, but we an imperishable one. I therefore run in this way, not as though without a clear aim; I fight in this way, not as one beating the air, but I chastise my body and bring it into subjection, lest perhaps, after preaching to others, I myself should become disqualified. For I do not want you to be ignorant, brothers, that our fathers were all under the cloud, and all passed through the sea; and all were baptized in Moses, in the cloud and in the sea; and all ate the same spiritual food, and all drank the same spiritual drink — for they drank from the spiritual rock that followed them, and the rock was Christ — but God was not pleased with most of them.

a.g: And they indeed do so to receive a perishable crown
but we do so to receive an imperishable one
as though without a clear aim
after I have preached to others,
our fathers were all under the cloud
from the spiritual rock that followed them
God was not pleased with most of them
